gates.evidence: One pale industrial humanoid has an empty camera-facing shoulder socket. A separate arm rests on the cloth-covered bench below it; frayed multicolor cable ends are visible at both detached ends. The whole photograph contains all components together.
The empty circular socket is integrated into the robot shoulder/chest casing; the optical head, neck, torso and remaining arm belong to that same pictured machine.

The lower frayed cable bundle visibly emerges from the detached arm proximal end under its pale shell, with loose exposed strands extending left/up, separately from the upper body bundle.
The upper cable bundle is visible inside the dark shoulder socket and projects outward into separate frayed strand tips; its origin remains on the robot body.
